why: Slice 8 of docs/plan/quests/rules-and-records-build-PLAN.md, today's tooling (kalfa/records): built @kalfa/records so the 13 laws L1 to L8 are green (every file one at a time, fast depth and FABRIKA_TEST_DEPTH=full): package.json and its pnpm-lock.yaml importer, README.md, and src/{Status,Frontmatter,Finding,Patches,Links,MapSize,Settings,cli,bin}.ts, with Tracked.ts (the git ls-files service the laws import) and two small helpers, Prose.ts (lines outside fenced code, inline code removed) and Comments.ts (the comments of a code file) that Patches.ts and Links.ts share. Each law's plant was made once on the real product and seen red, then undone (L1 to L8, plus the id-as-number plant of the L2 scenario). Two things stay open and are in the report: the two laws that fail the package's tsc with an Effect-language-service error (Frontmatter.test.ts:178, Patches.test.ts:268), and Records.test-support.ts's unused export Entry, which lint:dead names. The boundary entry for kalfa/records is added with kalfa-config only, as briefed; the laws also import @kampus/vitest, so lint:boundaries is red until the lead decides.
note: A Claude subagent in a cloud session; model and effort are the requested values. Started is approximate, ended is an estimate written just before the commit; usage and cost are not recorded. Node here is v22 and every node, pnpm and vitest command ran on a Node 26.13.0 outside the repo. The brief's check command `vitest run kalfa/records/` is refused by the test config as a broad run, so each test file ran by its own path.
